name: Faceless niche slideshow (content-first, product as one tip)
platforms: [TikTok photo mode, Instagram carousel, Pinterest idea pins, Facebook carousel]

shots.visual: The page's signature photo (same one every post: a faceless couple / hands / a view), slightly darkened so white text reads
shots.audio_text: Title in TikTok "Classic" font, white with black shadow, 6-10 words: "rules we made after we almost broke up"

shots.visual: Same photo or a close variant
shots.audio_text: Tip 1, written like a diary line: "1. no phones at dinner. not even face down."
Tip 2, slightly vulnerable: "2. we say the annoying thing the same day"

shots.visual: Same photo; the product is NOT pictured big. Optional small inset of it worn
shots.audio_text: Tip 3 IS the product, framed as a habit: "3. matching necklaces we never take off. even in the shower (ours are from [brand])"
Tip 4, the most emotional one, so the product slide is sandwiched
Soft close: "save this for the next hard week". No CTA, no link.

prompts.prompt: candid film photo of a couple seen from behind sitting on a sea wall at golden hour, faces not visible, her hand on his knee, thin gold chain on her neck, soft grain, 35mm, muted warm tones, vertical 9:16 --style raw

Write 10 slideshow scripts for a faceless relationship page. Each: a 6-10 word title in lowercase, 5 numbered tips in the voice of a woman writing in her notes app. In exactly one tip per script, mention [product] as a habit the couple has, never as a recommendation. No hashtags, no emojis.

qa_checklist: Hook lands in the first 1.5 s (video) or is readable at thumbnail size (static / slide 1).
Removal test: delete the product from the script. If it still makes sense, rewrite so the product is the payoff.
Matches the reference structure (same beat order and length band) before any creative twist.
Uses only real product imagery for the product; AI is for backgrounds, characters or b-roll, and is disclosed where required.
Every claim is on the brand's approved-claims list (PDP); no invented stats, reviews, doctors or customers.
Captions burned in and inside the safe zone; sound-off still understandable.
One clear CTA that matches the landing page offer.
Three hook variants delivered for the same body (test hooks, not whole new ads).
Avoid: Changing the photo every post kills the page identity; the repeat image IS the brand.
Avoid: The product slide must read like a tip, not an ad. If it says "shop now" the slideshow loses saves.
Avoid: Post 1-3 times a day from a warmed account for 2+ weeks before judging; one slideshow is not a test.
Avoid: Use AI or licensed photos only; never lift a real couple's photo.
inputs: BRAND (name, product, price, offer, audience, proof points, banned claims)
ASSETS (real product photos/video, logo, fonts, colors)
outputs: brands/<brand-slug>.md with 3 concepts in the output schema below
per concept: script/slide copy, shot list, on-screen text, caption, CTA, 3 hook variants, prompts used
